instructions.name: cancel_capsule
docs: Cancel an active capsule (owner only): refund assets and close the accounts.

instructions.name: crank_undelegate
docs: Commit ER state and undelegate the Switch back to the base layer (crank-callable).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone can call this (crank wallet).

instructions.name: crank_undelegate_beneficiaries
docs: Commit + undelegate the BeneficiarySet (and its permission) back to base: the privacy reveal,
gated on the owner OR an already-fired, base-committed Switch (crank-callable post-fire).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone can call this once the switch has fired (crank wallet); or the owner, to reveal early.

accounts.name: switch
docs: base (program-owned) for the dead-man path. Seeds [b"intent_capsule", owner].

instructions.name: create_capsule
docs: Create the Switch + Vault for an owner (liveness + heartbeat authority + creation fee).

accounts.name: platform_fee_recipient
docs: Platform fee recipient (must match fee_config.fee_recipient when creation_fee_lamports > 0).

instructions.name: delegate_beneficiaries
docs: Delegate the private BeneficiarySet to the TEE behind a PER permission (owner-only member).

instructions.name: delegate_capsule
docs: Delegate the Switch (liveness only) to a regular MagicBlock ER. Token-free heartbeats.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Lock SOL or SPL into the Vault (repeatable; owner only).

accounts.name: capsule
docs: Account<IntentCapsule>) on purpose: while the Switch is delegated its owner is the delegation
program, so an Account<IntentCapsule> would fail Anchor's owner check (error 3007) - yet the
Vault is always on the base layer, so deposits must keep working in that state (same pattern as
recover_vault). Authorization is the owner signer + the owner-seeded capsule/vault PDAs;
is_active is enforced in the handler only when the Switch is base-resident (program-owned).

instructions.name: distribute_assets
docs: Distribute one asset from the Vault to beneficiaries by share_bps (base layer, post-grace).

accounts.name: beneficiary_set
docs: The (now-revealed) beneficiary list. Must already be committed back to base
(crank_undelegate_beneficiaries) - while delegated to the TEE this account is not program-owned
and Anchor's Account<> owner-check would reject it, which is exactly the privacy guarantee.

instructions.name: distribute_nft
docs: Transfer one standard SPL NFT to its explicitly assigned recipient after the grace period.

instructions.name: execute_intent
docs: Fire the Switch when the inactivity period elapses (permissionless; state-only).

instructions.name: init_fee_config
docs: Initialize the platform fee config (call once after deploy; authority = deployer).

accounts.name: program
docs: This program, used to resolve its ProgramData account.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData (BPF upgradeable loader). Constrains init to the program's
upgrade authority (the deployer), so the global fee singleton cannot be front-run on a
fresh deploy by an attacker setting themselves as fee authority (audit C3).

instructions.name: recover_vault
docs: Owner escape hatch: recover one Vault asset while active, without touching the Switch.

accounts.name: capsule
docs: Account<IntentCapsule>) on purpose: while the Switch is delegated its owner is the delegation
program, so an Account<IntentCapsule> would fail Anchor's owner check - and the stuck-delegated
(dead validator) case is exactly what this escape hatch exists for. Authorization is the owner
signer + the owner-seeded vault, not this account.

instructions.name: recreate_capsule
docs: Reuse an executed capsule by resetting its lifecycle in place (owner only).

accounts.name: beneficiary_set
docs: Reset alongside the Switch. Must be back on base (undelegated) - same as the Switch after a
completed distribution. Re-delegate + re-set beneficiaries via update_intent to re-arm privacy.

instructions.name: schedule_execute_intent
docs: Register a MagicBlock ScheduleTask crank that re-runs execute_intent at intervals.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer who signs the schedule transaction (on the ER RPC).

instructions.name: update_activity
docs: Proof-of-life: bump last_activity or revive during grace (owner OR heartbeat authority).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Owner OR heartbeat_authority - enforced in the handler against the capsule.

instructions.name: update_fee_config
docs: Update the platform creation fee (authority only).

instructions.name: update_intent
docs: Set or replace the private beneficiary list (owner only; route via the PER once delegated).

instructions.name: update_nft_assignments
docs: Set or replace private per-NFT recipients (owner only; route via the PER once delegated).

fields.name: mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` for native SOL, otherwise the SPL mint distributed in this call.

types.name: Beneficiary
docs: One inheritance beneficiary and its share of every distributed asset, in basis points.
Shares across the set must sum to `BPS_DENOMINATOR` (10000 = 100%).
`reserved` pads each entry for a future cross-chain-heir field (e.g. a 20-byte EVM address + a
chain tag, when the CCIP heir module returns). Per-element width is the ONE dimension that
account-level padding cannot cover, so we reserve it up front to avoid a later resize of every
BeneficiarySet.

types.name: BeneficiarySet
docs: Per-owner private beneficiary list. Delegated to the TEE from creation; carries no funds and no
liveness - the Switch owns liveness, the base Vault owns assets.

types.name: CapsuleVault
docs: Vault PDA holds SOL/SPL locked at capsule creation; anyone can trigger execute when conditions are met.

types.name: NftAssignment
docs: One standard SPL NFT and the wallet that receives it after the grace period. The mint must have
supply 1 and decimals 0 when `distribute_nft` executes. Assignments live inside the same TEE-
resident account as proportional beneficiaries, so the intended heir stays private while alive.
